metaDescription: Order custom gray paper bags in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Ideal for retail and events. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Gray paper bags offer a neutral, sophisticated alternative to standard brown or white. They complement modern branding with a subtle, earthy tone that works well for retail packaging, gift shops, and trade shows. Choose from twisted paper handles or flat handles, and add your logo with screen printing or foil stamping for a polished look. These bags are available in various sizes to accommodate merchandise, promotional gifts, or event materials.
heroAltText: Stack of custom gray paper bags with twisted handles and screen-printed logo, ideal for retail branding
